label: D1 after an unrewarded a1->S1 (common) trial, late in the episode (trial >= ~72)
explanation: Fires only at D1 (never GO/D2), only when the reward input is 0 (previous trial unrewarded), and only in the last ~30 trials of the episode (none before trial 60). The previous trial is almost always a1 reaching S1 via a common transition: adding that condition raises precision from ~0.23 to ~0.85. Unrewarded a1->S2 rare, a2->S2, or a2->S1 rare give little or no activation. Magnitude rises steeply with episode position: at trial >= 90 the predicate has precision 0.999 and covers 81% of the top activation quartile, while trials 72-84 make up mostly the low quartiles. It also co-occurs with low model value. Most misses are weak activations on D1 after other unrewarded outcomes or earlier in the episode. All variables are observed, so no future variables are used. It acts like an episode-time-gated detector for an unrewarded S1 outcome after choosing a1.
